# Host-side Python dependencies of tools/*.py and pcb/*.py, pinned to the
# versions these tools were run with (Python 3.13, x86_64 Linux, 2026-10-23):
# lxml 6.1.3 and PyMuPDF 2.0 plus everything PyMuPDF 2.0 itself requires.
# Every file PyPI publishes for each pinned version is listed by SHA-256, so
# the lock works on any platform with a wheel and refuses substituted files:
#
#     python3 -m venv .venv
#     .venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r tools/requirements.txt
#
# Not covered here, by design:
#   * KiCad 10 (kicad-cli, and pcbnew/numpy/scipy for pcb/*.py) and Pandoc are
#     system packages, not PyPI wheels.
#   * Dependencies of the software under test (numpy, onnx, onnxruntime,
#     PySide6 for tools/run_tests_offline.py and tools/check_software.py) are
#     declared in software/pyproject.toml; the guest wheelhouse is locked in
#     deployment/linux_lab/wheelhouse-requirements.txt.
#
# PyMuPDF is AGPL-3.0. The tools import it as "pymupdf" (fallback: "fitz").
# To update: change the versions, then regenerate the hashes from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json (all "urls" sha256 digests).
